financing.summary: Perry Homes is a family-owned private builder (Owner and Executive Chair Kathy Perry Britton) with no public debt, no SEC filings and no credit rating, so its bank lines, lenders, leverage and lot position are not public. Its land model is to buy finished lots from master-plan developers through builder programs: in its own words it 'relies on strong developer partnerships', and every Florida entry since 2024 has been announced alongside a named developer (Eisenhower, GreenPointe, Forestar, Metro Development, Tavistock, Wheelock/Gentry, Brookfield Kolter, Raydient). The exceptions are Juniper Springs in Lockhart, TX, where Perry is itself the developer of about 1,400 homesites, and new acreage-lot product in Central Texas and Dallas-Fort Worth. No land banker or lot-option financier is publicly linked to Perry. The opening for a land banker is the Florida build-out (five markets and about 15 communities in under three years, plus the December 2024 MasterCraft purchase in Jacksonville) and Perry's first self-developed community, both of which need more land capital than the Texas finished-lot business has historically required.
financing.land_strategy: Finished-lot buyer in third-party master-planned communities, plus selective self-development. Company framing: 'We rely on strong developer partnerships' (Chris Little, President of Central Texas and Florida, July 2026) and growth 'driven by ... partnering with best-in-class developers' (April 2026 release). Perry acts as developer at Juniper Springs, Lockhart (about 1,400 homes). No owned-versus-optioned target or land-light goal has been stated publicly.

lots.note: Not publicly disclosed (private company, no filings). Scale indicators from the company: '150+ active communities' (Florida landing page, November 2026); 21 active communities in the Austin area and 30 in San Antonio (July 2026 release); 2026 Builder 100 rank No. 22. The site map on 2026-11-19 lists 15 named Florida communities (Tampa 7, Southwest Florida 3, Jacksonville 3, Orlando 2, Southeast Florida 1) against roughly 225 Texas community pages, some of which may be sold out.

land_banking.counterparty: Perry Homes (self-developed: Juniper Springs, Lockhart TX)
land_banking.description: Perry Homes is itself the developer and the only builder at Juniper Springs in Lockhart (Austin area), planned for about 1,400 homes on 45', 50' and 60' lots with a third of the land kept as open space and an on-site elementary school. The community site calls it Perry's move into development and a 'legacy project'. Sales inquiries opened June 2025; grand opening May 2026.
land_banking.source_title: Juniper Springs community site, Builders page (copyright Perry Homes, Inc.)
land_banking.note: This is owned and developed land, the capital-heavy exception to Perry's finished-lot model, and the clearest opening for land-bank or development capital. How Perry funds the development (bank debt, equity, district reimbursements) is not disclosed. Home count is from Perry's July 2025 release (company-news/perry-homes-continues-tradition-of-excellence-with-new-juniper-springs-community-in-lockhart).

land_banking.description: Perry Homes is a listed builder with at least five model homes or sections in Bridgeland (including 45' and 55' product in separate villages), a Howard Hughes master-planned community in the Houston area.
land_banking.source_title: Bridgeland: Builders & Model Homes (Howard Hughes Communities)
land_banking.note: Example of the Texas finished-lot model. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. Perry's site map also lists The Woodlands Hills, another community carrying the Howard Hughes Communities copyright; the builder page there did not load.

land_banking.description: Perry Homes is one of nine listed builders at Elyson in Katy (homes from the low $400s). The Elyson site states that Brookfield Residential Properties ULC or an affiliate is the master developer or development manager and that builders are independent third parties.
land_banking.note: Brookfield is acting as lot developer here, not as a land banker. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. Verifier 2026-11-19: builder count corrected from ten to nine (the Elyson builders page lists nine).

land_banking.counterparty: Forestar Group (Star Farms at Lakewood Ranch, FL)
land_banking.description: Forestar brought Perry Homes into its 'luxury builder program' at Star Farms at Lakewood Ranch (1,300 acres, 2,800 homes planned). Perry builds on 50' to 90' homesites; models opened September 2026 with prices from the $700s.
land_banking.source_title: Forestar Introduces Perry Homes to Star Farms at Lakewood Ranch and Growth of Luxury Builder Program (Forestar release on Perry newsroom, dated 2025-08-15)
land_banking.note: Forestar is the lot developer and seller. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. Follow-ups: Perry newsroom 2026-02-23 and 2026-09-18. Forestar quoted: Tony Squitieri, West Florida Region Vice President.

land_banking.description: Perry's main Tampa lot source. Berry Bay in Wimauma was named at the February 2024 Florida launch; the Reserve at Berry Bay opened July 2026; and in April 2026 Perry announced three more Eisenhower communities in North Tampa / Pasco County: Hillcrest, Morris Bend and Two Rivers.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Expands Florida Presence with Three New Communities in North Tampa and Pasco County (2026-04-20)
land_banking.note: Four communities with one developer is the deepest repeat relationship visible in Florida. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. Eisenhower quoted: Jeffery Hills, President and CEO.

land_banking.counterparty: GreenPointe Developers / GreenPointe Holdings (Southern Hills, Brooksville FL; Glynlea, Port St. Lucie FL)
land_banking.description: GreenPointe supplied Perry's first Florida community, Southern Hills in Brooksville (first home started May 2024). Perry's May 2024 release also names Glynlea as a GreenPointe Holdings community; Perry opened models at Glynlea Country Club in November 2025 as its first Southeast Florida community.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Breaks Ground on First Florida Home in Southern Hills (2024-05-23)
land_banking.note: Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. GreenPointe quoted: Jim McGowan (Regional President) and Grady Miars (President and COO, GreenPointe Holdings).

land_banking.counterparty: Metro Development Group (The Sanctuary at Seaire, Parrish FL)
land_banking.description: Perry plans more than 130 homes in The Sanctuary at Seaire, a Metro Development Group lagoon community in Parrish; grand opening July 2026. Perry's May 2024 release had named Metro Development as the partner for a Parrish Lakes community.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Celebrates Grand Opening of The Sanctuary at Seaire in Parrish (2026-07-27)
land_banking.note: 'lots' is the planned home count stated by Perry (more than 130), not a disclosed contract. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed.

land_banking.counterparty: Tavistock Development Company (Weslyn Park at Sunbridge, Orlando FL)
land_banking.description: Perry joined Tavistock's builder group at Weslyn Park, the first neighborhood of the 27,000-acre Sunbridge master plan, announced May 2026.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Debuts in Desirable Tavistock Community, the Weslyn Park neighborhood in Sunbridge (2026-05-27)
land_banking.note: Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. Tavistock quoted: Rob Adams, senior vice president of residential development.

land_banking.counterparty: Wheelock Communities and Gentry Land (Waterlin, St. Cloud FL)
land_banking.description: Perry is in the builder program at Waterlin, a 6,000-acre master plan in St. Cloud (Orlando area), announced July 2026. Perry's May 2024 release names Wheelock Communities and Gentry Land as the Waterlin developers.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Announces Entry into Waterlin, a New Master-Planned Community in Orlando (2026-07-06)
land_banking.note: Developer names come from the 2024-05-23 Southern Hills release; the 2026 release quotes Reed Berlinsky as 'Waterlin Development Partner' without naming the firm. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed.

land_banking.counterparty: Brookfield Kolter Land Partners (Solaeris, Port St. Lucie FL)
land_banking.description: Perry is one of the launch builders at Solaeris, a 3,300-acre Brookfield Kolter master plan west of Port St. Lucie planned for up to 8,100 homes in 11 neighborhoods; announced October 2026.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Brings Luxury Living to Solaeris, the Treasure Coast's New Master-Planned Community (2026-10-28)
land_banking.note: A Brookfield-affiliated land platform acting as master developer and lot seller. Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed. Quoted: Josh Long, Vice President of planning and entitlement, Brookfield Kolter Land Partners.

land_banking.counterparty: Raydient Places + Properties / Rayonier (Wildlight Garden District, Nassau County FL)
land_banking.description: Perry and Toll Brothers build the first Garden District neighborhood, Bellflower, on 50', 60' and 70' lots at Wildlight; builders were named in September 2025 and Perry announced its entry in October 2026 with models due early 2027. Rayonier, through Raydient, is master developer of the 24,000-acre community.
land_banking.source_title: Perry Homes Continues Tradition of Excellence with Expansion into Jacksonville with Wildlight Community (2026-10-20)
land_banking.note: Master-developer identity and the September 2025 builder selection are from the Jacksonville Daily Record (2025-09-22 and 2026-09-29). Lot purchase or option terms, deposit, takedown schedule and lot count are not disclosed.

land_banking.counterparty: Creekview GP LLC (Creekview Trail, Green Cove Springs FL)
land_banking.description: Perry Homes of Florida LLC bought 30 residential lots in Creekview Trail Area 4A for $4,275,000 in a deed recorded March 2-8, 2026 (about $142,500 a lot).
land_banking.source_title: Top commercial sales of the week (Jacksonville Daily Record, 2026-03-12)
land_banking.note: County-record lot takedown in the former MasterCraft market. Per-lot figure is my arithmetic. Seller's ownership is not stated.

land_banking.counterparty: Creekview GP LLC (Creekview Trail, Green Cove Springs FL)
land_banking.description: Second recorded takedown in the same phase: Perry Homes of Florida LLC bought 10 residential lots in Creekview Trail Area 4A for $1,524,692 in a deed recorded October 26 to November 1, 2026 (about $152,500 a lot).
land_banking.source_title: Top commercial sales of the week (Jacksonville Daily Record, 2026-11-05)
land_banking.note: Together with the March deed: 40 lots for about $5.8M in 2026, bought in phases from the developer, which is how a rolling finished-lot takedown looks in the records. Per-lot figure is my arithmetic.

joint_ventures.partner: Executive Title Agency (affiliate, formerly Executive Title Company)
joint_ventures.description: Title agency founded in 1995 and described by Perry as its affiliate; renamed Executive Title Agency on 2025-10-22. Not a land or capital joint venture; listed so the affiliate is on the map. Ownership split not disclosed.
joint_ventures.source_title: Executive Title Company Announces Name Change to Executive Title Agency (2025-10-22)
joint_ventures.note: President: Landon Smith (appointed December 2024, per Perry newsroom 2024-12-06).

joint_ventures.partner: Crestmark Mortgage Company, Ltd. and Parkstone Mortgage, LLC
joint_ventures.description: The two mortgage lenders Perry presents to buyers on its financing page. The site carries separate affiliated-business-arrangement disclosure pages for each lender, which points to an ownership or referral tie; the structure and any ownership share are not stated on the pages opened.
joint_ventures.note: Inferred from the existence of '-aba' disclosure paths in the site's robots.txt; the disclosure pages themselves were not opened. Buyer mortgage arrangement only, no bearing on land or corporate financing.

competitor_links.relationship: Lot developer and seller to Perry at Star Farms at Lakewood Ranch (Sarasota area) under Forestar's luxury builder program since August 2025. Not a land-bank facility; terms not disclosed.
competitor_links.source_title: Forestar Introduces Perry Homes to Star Farms at Lakewood Ranch and Growth of Luxury Builder Program

competitor_links.firm: Brookfield (Brookfield Kolter Land Partners; Brookfield Residential)
competitor_links.relationship: Brookfield platforms are master developers of two communities where Perry builds: Solaeris in Port St. Lucie (Brookfield Kolter Land Partners, announced October 2026) and Elyson in Katy, TX (Brookfield Residential). Developer-to-builder lot sales, not land banking; terms not disclosed.
competitor_links.source_title: Perry Homes Brings Luxury Living to Solaeris (2026-10-28); Elyson builder page at https://www.elyson.com/homes/homebuilders/
competitor_links.note: No public link between Perry Homes and Domain Real Estate Partners, Millrose Properties, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found, but those names could not be searched one by one in this run (see gaps).

ma.description: Perry Homes bought MasterCraft Builder Group, a Jacksonville-area builder founded in 2011 by Chris Shee and run with his brother Brad Shee. Terms were not disclosed. Builder Advisor Group advised the seller. Perry keeps the MasterCraft Builder Group brand in select Jacksonville communities.
ma.map_impact: Creates Perry's Jacksonville / Northeast Florida division, its fifth Florida market. Brad Shee is quoted in October 2026 as Division President for Perry Homes in Jacksonville, so the seller's co-founder now runs the division. A Florida entity, Perry Homes of Florida LLC, is taking down finished lots in Clay County (40 lots at Creekview Trail in 2026). Deal price, lots and backlog acquired are not public.
ma.source_title: Perry Homes Announces Acquisition of Florida-Based MasterCraft Builder Group (2024-12-03)
ma.note: Announced one month before the 2025 window; included because it is Perry's only acquisition on record and defines the Florida map. Also reported by the Jacksonville Daily Record (2024-12-03, 'terms of the deal were not disclosed') and listed on Builder Advisor Group's site as a December 2024 sell-side mandate.

gaps: Search limits in this run: the shared web-search allowance was already used up, so no search-engine queries were run for Perry Homes. Everything here comes from pages opened directly (the company newsroom read end to end, 61 releases from 2023 to 2026-11-11; developer and community sites; Jacksonville Daily Record; Builder Advisor Group; Bisnow). Treat 'none found' below as 'not found on those pages', not 'confirmed none'.
Lots owned / optioned / total controlled and years of supply: not publicly disclosed (private company, no SEC filings).
Revolving credit facility, term loans, agent bank and lender group: not publicly disclosed. No lender is named in any company release.
Notes or other public debt: none found; Perry Homes does not appear to have issued public or 144A notes. Not confirmed on EDGAR.
Cash, total debt, liquidity, net debt to capital, fiscal year end: not publicly disclosed.
Credit ratings: none found; no rated public debt identified.
Capital events 2025 to 2026 (debt raises, facility amendments, equity, recapitalisation): none publicly announced on the pages opened.

Land bankers and lot-option financiers (Domain Real Estate Partners, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis, TPG Angelo Gordon, DW Partners, Essential Housing, IHP Capital, Oaktree, GTIS, Hearthstone, Walton): no link appears in any Perry release, but these names were NOT searched individually (no search allowance). Varde's own press-room search for 'Perry Homes' returned no results. Forestar and Brookfield links found are developer lot sales, recorded above.

Lot purchase and option contract terms with developers (deposits, takedown pace, price escalators, lot counts per community): not publicly disclosed. Only two recorded Clay County, FL takedowns were found with prices.
Juniper Springs (self-developed, about 1,400 homes): land seller, acreage price, development lender and any special-district financing are not disclosed on the pages opened.

Texas developer relationships are only sampled (Howard Hughes at Bridgeland, Brookfield Residential at Elyson). Perry's site lists roughly 225 Texas community pages; the master developer of each was not traced.
MasterCraft Builder Group acquisition: price, lots controlled, closings and backlog acquired, and how it was funded are not disclosed.

M&A 2025 to date: no acquisition, sale or merger appears in the company newsroom through 2026-11-11 and its September 2026 company history lists MasterCraft as the only acquisition. Trade-press search could not be run.
Ownership and equity: described by the company as family-owned and woman-owned with Kathy Perry Britton as Owner; no outside equity investor, ESOP or cap table is public.

Pages that would not open: Bisnow's February 2026 Houston MPC article shows only the first part without an account and attributes no remarks to Perry's CEO in the visible part; GlobeNewswire organisation page, Inc. profile and Business Wire search returned 403; WebFetch was rate-limited for perryhomes.com, bisnow.com and globenewswire.com, so pages were read with curl instead.
